results.question: I lost my license email, what do I do?
results.answer:
Use the **“Can’t find your license email?”** form on any plugin page or the downloads page.  
- Enter the email address you used to purchase the plugin.  
- The same license (or all licenses you own) will be re‑sent to that address.  

If you no longer have access to that inbox, write to us from your new address with your order details and we’ll sort it out manually.  

Use the form below to resend the license.

results.question: I bought the bundle, do I get one license or several?
results.answer:
**One license per plugin.**  
Your bundle email contains a separate `.frlicense` line for each plugin (Trammel, Remanence, Amnesia, Fifty‑Fifty, Jointer, Firmament, Keelson, Undercroft, and the free Clew). Paste each line into the corresponding plugin or drop all the files into your licenses folder to activate the whole bundle.

results.question: How do I activate my license?
results.answer:
To activate a plugin license:

- Open the plugin’s window and click the **FR** mark on its panel.  
- Paste the license line that appears in the email into the field that shows up, then reload the session. The panel will say “Accepted – reload the session to activate.”  

**Or** copy the `.frlicense` files that were attached to your purchase email into the folder below (create it if it doesn’t exist) and reload the session:

- macOS: `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`  
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\`

Every license in that folder is activated at once.  

If you can’t locate the email with the license line or files, use the “Can’t find your license email?” link on the site.

results.question: The plugin says Not a license for this plugin
results.answer:
That message means you pasted the wrong license line – it belongs to a different plugin.  
**Fix it by**  
- opening the plugin you’re working with,  
- clicking the **FR mark** on its panel,  
- pasting the license line that the email labels for that exact plugin,  
- reloading the session (or removing and re‑adding the plugin).  

If you still see the error after that, put the corresponding `.frlicense` file in  
`~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/` (macOS) or `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\` (Windows) and reload. If it still won’t activate, write to us through the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: I pasted my license but it still says unlicensed
results.answer:
- **Reload** the session: close the DAW or the plugin window and reopen it.  
- Make sure you pasted the **entire license line** exactly as it appears in the email.  
- Verify that the license line is for the plugin you’re using (each license is labeled with the plugin name).  
- If it still shows “Demo ended – not licensed”, try placing the `.frlicense` file in the licenses folder.  

If none of these steps work, please let us know by using the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: I got a new computer, how do I move my license over?
results.answer:
Install the plugins on the new computer, then copy your license to that machine.  
- On macOS, place any `.frlicense` files in `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`.  
- On Windows, place them in `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\`.  

If you no longer have the email that received the license, use the **“Can’t find your license email?”** option to have the licenses sent to that inbox.  

**Use the form below** if you need a new license email sent.

results.question: What happens when the demo ends?
results.answer: When the 14‑day demo expires the plugin **continues to load and pass audio**, but every ~45 s a brief (~1 s) faded silence is inserted to signal it is unlicensed. The plugin never mutes a track outright, never does it in the first 30 s of playback, and a bar across the panel indicates the status and what to do. The demo ends only with this audible reminder; the rest of the session continues normally.
